question: Should routine restart-required `config.patch` and `config.apply` writes in `gateway.reload.mode: "hot"` retain current main’s direct-restart behavior, or intentionally adopt the watcher’s warn-and-keep behavior?
rationale: Both options are plausible, but the branch changes an existing gateway API/operator contract and the security carve-out alone does not determine the intended routine-write policy.

options.title: Preserve direct RPC restart
options.body: Keep the existing direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes while applying the new security carve-out to watcher and security-critical paths.

options.title: Adopt watcher parity
options.body: Accept routine RPC warn-and-keep behavior in hot mode and document that API writes require an explicit restart or hybrid mode for restart-required edits.

recommendation.title: Preserve direct RPC restart
recommendation.body: Keep the existing direct restart for routine restart-required RPC writes while applying the new security carve-out to watcher and security-critical paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has documented the exact policy split and can incorporate the chosen gateway-owner direction; formal ownership was not recoverable in this review environment.
